candidate.original_question: What right, duty, or requirement is described in the clause beginning “(2) The Governor shall cause every recommendation made…”?
candidate.original_answer:
(2) The Governor  shall cause every recommendation made by the
Commission under this article together with an explanatory memorandum as to
the action taken thereon to be laid before the Legislature of the State.
candidate.proposed_question: What must the Governor lay before the State Legislature under Article 243Y(2)?
candidate.proposed_answer: The Governor shall cause every recommendation made by the Commission under Article 243Y, together with an explanatory memorandum as to the action taken, to be laid before the State Legislature.
candidate.source_text_finding: Article 243Y(2) requires the Governor to lay the Commission recommendations under that article and an explanatory memorandum on action taken before the State Legislature.
